description: Edit an existing 1Password item. Update the title, notes (pass an empty string to clear notes), tags, website URL, upsert fields, or remove fields. Only referenced fields are changed; all others are preserved.

fields.description: Fields to upsert (create or update) by id or title.

idOrTitle.description: Field id or title to match (case-insensitive). Created if absent.

section.description: Optional section id to associate the field with.

type.description: Field type: 'text' for plain values, 'concealed' for secrets.

notes.description: Full replacement of the item's notes. Pass an empty string to clear notes.

removeFields.description: Field ids or titles to remove from the item.

tags.description: Replacement set of tags (replaces all existing tags).

url.description: Replacement primary website URL for the item.

name: item_edit
